app.title: JusticeNow
app.tagline: Report a human rights concern safely and anonymously.

common.comingSoon: This page is coming in the next sprint.

home.privacyNote: No account is needed to use JusticeNow. We never ask for your name, phone number, or email. You will receive a secure reference code to check your case status later.

report.privacyReassurance: We never ask for your name. Nothing on this form identifies you.
report.caseType: What kind of incident is this?
report.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what happened. Do not include your own name or contact details.
report.descriptionPrivacyHint: Tip: leave out anything that could identify you.
report.evidenceHint: A photo or document, if you have one. The filename is discarded on upload.

errors.submitFailed: Could not submit the report. Please check your connection and try again.

success.title: Your report has been received
success.writeItDown: Write this code down or take a screenshot now.
success.explanation: This code is the ONLY way to check on your case later. We cannot recover it for you, because we do not know who you are.
